import html from typing import Any # Template used to format the invitation. INVITATION_FORMAT: str = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes_block}
""" def _ensure_string(value: Any, name: str) -> str: """ Ensure the supplied value is a string. If not, raise ValueError. """ if not isinstance(value, str): raise ValueError(f"'{name}' must be a string (got {type(value).__name__})") return value def render_event_invitation( event_title: str, event_description: str, event_date: str, additional_notes: str ) -> str: """ Return a sanitized HTML string representing an event invitation. Parameters ---------- event_title : str Title of the event. event_description : str Full description (may contain newlines). event_date : str Date of the event. additional_notes : str Any extra user-provided notes. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML ready for rendering. Raises ------ ValueError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate types event_title = _ensure_string(event_title, "event_title") event_description = _ensure_string(event_description, "event_description") event_date = _ensure_string(event_date, "event_date") additional_notes = _ensure_string(additional_notes, "additional_notes") # Escape all user-provided content to avoid XSS esc_title = html.escape(event_title, quote=True) esc_description = html.escape(event_description, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") esc_date = html.escape(event_date, quote=True) esc_notes = html.escape(additional_notes, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Build the optional notes block additional_notes_block = ( f'

Notes: {esc_notes}

' if esc_notes.strip() else "" ) # Render the final invitation rendered = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=esc_title, event_description=esc_description, event_date=esc_date, additional_notes_block=additional_notes_block ) return rendered.strip()
